answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral, so splitting stake across aliases does not dilute accountability: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties scale as O(k²), reflecting pairwise evidence and compounding losses. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making a controlled sybil swarm increasingly costly; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from erasing the hit. Even an island of aliases cannot escape shared control, though no sonnet or zenith of rhetoric substitutes for verifiable links.
